protocol.purpose: Diagnostic phase traces and function samples of unchanged published binary; no qualification or candidate changes
protocol.timing_interpretation: trace-enabled phase times only; reuse original campaign full-command comparison
protocol.noise_policy: ordinary desktop noise retained; no builds/tests/agent source reads during capture; no retries for unfavorable results

sampling.science_coverage: N and residual DoF asserted for each loop fit; final b, V and RSS independently checked. Only the 36 trace fits have every coefficient/covariance vector exported and checked.

sampling_interpretation: All-thread sample counts are hotspot witnesses, not wall-time shares. Profiled loops are not performance estimates. Stata internal routines are stripped, so no exact current kernel implementation is inferred from them.

reproduction.preparation: Use reproduction.prepare_source from simple-regress-macos-20261101.json with the same NumPy and SciPy versions and WORK_DIRECTORY. Build the unchanged bench/clock.c with bench/build_clock.py. Replace WORK_DIRECTORY and REPOSITORY_DIRECTORY in phase_stata_source. Run phase_stata_source with FEREG_PHASE_TIMING=1 and FEREG_SOLVER_TRACE=1. Run sample_runner_source from the work directory after replacing REPOSITORY_DIRECTORY. Profile loops have tracing disabled. Write the top-level protocol object to protocol.json in WORK_DIRECTORY before running the sampling supervisor or phase analyzer.
reproduction.phase_stata_source:
version 19
clear all
set more off
set varabbrev off
set linesize 255
adopath ++ "REPOSITORY_DIRECTORY/stata"
adopath ++ "REPOSITORY_DIRECTORY/dist"
quietly findfile fereg_macos.plugin
assert r(fn) == "REPOSITORY_DIRECTORY/dist/fereg_macos.plugin"
program _clock, plugin using("WORK_DIRECTORY/command-clock.plugin")
quietly use "WORK_DIRECTORY/data.dta", clear
mata: ft=fopen("WORK_DIRECTORY/timings.tsv","w"); fs=fopen("WORK_DIRECTORY/science.tsv","w")
program _run
    args arm k threads repetition
    local processors=min(`threads',c(processors_lic),c(processors_mach))
    set processors `processors'
    local options
    if "`arm'" == "fereg" local options , threads(`threads')
    tempname secs res
    scalar `secs'=.
    scalar `res'=.
    plugin call _clock, start
    capture noisily quietly `arm' y x1-x`k' `options'
    local rc=_rc
    plugin call _clock, stop `secs' `res'
    if `rc' exit `rc'
    assert scalar(`secs')>0 & scalar(`secs')<120
    assert scalar(`res')>0 & scalar(`res')<=0.0000005
    assert e(N)==1000000 & e(df_r)==1000000-`k'-1
    local native=.
    local input=.
    local preflight=.
    local total=.
    local workers=`processors'
    if "`arm'"=="fereg" {
        local native=el(e(fereg_runtime),20,2)
        local input=el(e(fereg_runtime),19,2)
        local preflight=el(e(fereg_runtime),18,2)
        local total=el(e(fereg_runtime),21,2)
        local workers=e(fereg_threads)
        assert `workers'==`threads'
        assert e(df_a)==1
    }
    mata: fput(ft, "`arm' `k' `threads' `processors' `repetition' "+strofreal(st_numscalar("`secs'"),"%24.17g")+" `native' `input' `preflight' `total' `workers'"); fput(fs,"`arm' `k' `threads' `repetition' "+invtokens(strofreal((st_matrix("e(b)"),vec(st_matrix("e(V)"))',st_numscalar("e(rss)"),st_numscalar("e(N)"),st_numscalar("e(N)")-st_numscalar("e(df_r)"),st_numscalar("e(df_r)")),"%24.17g")))
    display "DONE `arm' k=`k' t=`threads' rep=`repetition' secs=" scalar(`secs')
end

reproduction.phase_analysis_source:
from pathlib import Path
import json,math,statistics,hashlib
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;root=Path('REPOSITORY_DIRECTORY');old=json.loads((root/'bench/results/simple-regress-macos-20261101.json').read_text());prot=json.loads((p/'protocol.json').read_text());refs=old['science']['oracle_reference']
assert 'NATIVE_PROFILE_COMPLETE' in (p/'phases.log').read_text()
assert prot['plugin_sha256']==hashlib.sha256((root/'dist/fereg_macos.plugin').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
groups=[];group={}
for line in (p/'phases.stderr').read_text().splitlines():
 if not line.startswith('FEREG_PHASE|'):continue
 tokens=line.split('|');name=tokens[1];fields={}
 for item in tokens[2:]:
  key,value=item.split('=',1)
  try:fields[key]=float(value)
  except ValueError:fields[key]=value
 group.setdefault(name,[]).append(fields)
 if name=='iid_plugin':groups.append(group);group={}
assert not group and len(groups)==36
records=[];baselines={};maxb=maxv=maxrss=0.
for idx,(a,k,t,rep) in enumerate(prot['calls']):
 timing=(p/'timings.tsv').read_text().splitlines()[idx].split();s=(p/'science.tsv').read_text().splitlines()[idx].split()
 assert timing[:3]==[a,str(k),str(t)] and int(timing[4])==rep
 assert s[:4]==[a,str(k),str(t),str(rep)]
 v=list(map(float,s[4:]));d=k+1;b=v[:d];cov=v[d:d+d*d];rss,n,rank,df=v[-4:];ref=refs[str(k)]
 assert (n,rank,df)==(1e6,k+1,1e6-k-1)
 rb=ref['b'];rv=[ref['V'][i][j] for j in range(d) for i in range(d)]
 assert all(math.isclose(x,y,rel_tol=1e-7,abs_tol=1e-10) for x,y in zip(b,rb))
 assert all(math.isclose(x,y,rel_tol=1e-6,abs_tol=1e-10) for x,y in zip(cov,rv))
 assert math.isclose(rss,ref['rss'],rel_tol=1e-8,abs_tol=1e-10)
 key=(k,t)
 if key in baselines:assert v==baselines[key]
 else:baselines[key]=v
 maxb=max(maxb,max(abs(x-y) for x,y in zip(b,rb)));maxv=max(maxv,max(abs(x-y) for x,y in zip(cov,rv)));maxrss=max(maxrss,abs(rss/ref['rss']-1))
 records.append({'k':k,'threads':t,'repetition':rep,'outer_s':float(timing[5]),'native_s':float(timing[6]),'input_s':float(timing[7]),'phases':groups[idx]})
summary=[]
for k in (1,16,64):
 for t in (1,8,16):
  rs=[r for r in records if r['k']==k and r['threads']==t and r['repetition']>0]
  m=lambda fun:statistics.median(fun(r) for r in rs)
  ph=lambda name,key,ind=0:m(lambda r:r['phases'][name][ind][key])
  row={'k':k,'threads':t,'native':m(lambda r:r['native_s']),'input':m(lambda r:r['input_s']),'prepare':ph('iid_plugin','prepare'),'projection':ph('fit','projection'),'raw':ph('dense_raw','total'),'raw_rhs':ph('dense_raw','rhs'),'raw_moments':ph('dense_raw','moments'),'absorb':ph('project_dense','absorb'),'map_initial':ph('map_wrapper','initial_certificate'),'map_norms':ph('map_wrapper','norms'),'finite':ph('fit','finite_solve'),'bread':ph('fit','bread_raw_residual'),'residual':ph('fit','residual_absorb'),'finalize':ph('fit','finalize'),'iid':ph('iid','total')}
  summary.append(row);print(json.dumps(row))
result={'protocol':prot,'phase_records':records,'summary':summary,'science':{'fits':36,'all_pass':True,'fixed_workers_exact':True,'max_coefficient_error':maxb,'max_covariance_error':maxv,'max_rss_relative_error':maxrss},'hashes':{name:hashlib.sha256((p/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in ['phases.do','phases.stderr','timings.tsv','science.tsv']}}
(p/'phase-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
